args.title: Correct amount parsing for zero-decimal currencies like CLP
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

In zero-decimal currencies such as CLP, dot/period separators in bank amounts represent thousands separators (e.g. 12.500 for 12,500) rather than decimal points, but parseAmount currently strips commas and treats dots as decimal points for all currencies. Update amount parsing to handle zero-decimal currencies correctly without decimal scaling.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Bank files for zero-decimal currencies like CLP use dots as thousands separators (e.g. 12.500), which parseAmount incorrectly treats as decimal points and parses as fractional amounts or invalid numbers.
